MERCHANDIZE SVIZZERA MERCATO 100%
L'azienda
Swatch è uno dei marchi più popolari al mondo nel settore orologiero svizzero. Il primo orologio Swatch ha sorpreso il mondo con il loro concetto rivoluzionario, il design creativo e lo spirito provocatorio. La filosofia del marchio si basa sul colore, il movimento, la leggerezza e la trasparenza, tutti presenti in ogni prodotto e progetto Swatch. Il marchio afferma la sua presenza globale nel mondo dello sport e dell'arte.
Al fine di rafforzare il team di Merchandising nella regione di Swiss Romande, Swatch sta attualmente reclutando uno/uno
Come Merchandiser, sei responsabile della decorazione di negozi Swatch in Svizzera francofona. In questo ruolo chiave per l'immagine di marca, assicura l'aspetto attraente dei negozi e applica le linee guida di decorazione di Visual Merchandising.

MERCHANDIZE SWITZERLAND MARKET 100% - Swatch Group

MERCHANDIZE SWITZERLAND MARKET 100%
The company
Swatch is one of the world's most popular brands in the Swiss watch industry. The first Swatch watches surprised the world with their revolutionary concept, creative design and provocative spirit. The brand's philosophy is based on colour, movement, lightness and transparency, all of which are found in every Swatch product and project. The brand affirms its global presence in the world of sport and art.
In order to strengthen the Merchandising team on the Swiss Romande region, Swatch is currently recruiting one/one
As Merchandiser, you are responsible for decorating Swatch stores in French-speaking Switzerland. In this key role for brand image, you ensure the attractive look of stores and apply the decoration guidelines of Visual Merchandising.
Job description
• Overall responsibility of Visual Merchandising for Swatch and Flik Flak in French-speaking Switzerland, Valais, Jura and Bernese Region, including implementation of guidelines and respect for brand image
• Installation of attractive displays and sharp scenography to enhance visual impact and capture customer attention
• Regular visits of outlets according to commercial priorities, with control of assortment and decoration equipment
• Product implementation and application of merchandising plans within sales surfaces, ensuring consistent and qualitative presentation
• Optimization of the customer journey and adaptation of sales spaces according to new developments, inventory rotations and commercial objectives
• Monitoring and analysis of performance: monitoring of key indicators (sales, processing rates) and observation of market and competition trends
• Training, motivation and support of sales teams to ensure the optimal installation of collections and the impeccable holding of the exhibition
• Proposing new locations or activation ideas to boost promotions and increase in-store visibility
• Support during events and promotions: preparation, installation and coordination of special decorations or VM projects
• Administrative management including weekly planning, fee tracking and field coordination
• Profile
• Creativity and aesthetic sense: excellent control of space, volumes, colours and light
• Technical and manual skills: ease in tool handling and visual installation
• Rigor and organization: simultaneous management of several projects and strict adherence to new collections' calendars
• Relationship building: ability to communicate effectively with store managers and to unite teams around a visual project
• Open and communicative personality, with enthusiastic and focused solutions
• Proactive and entrepreneurial behaviour: taking initiatives and constantly seeking improvements
• Ability to impose and enforce presentation standards
• Self-employment and accountability in field missions
• Availability to travel, including for nights away
• Organizational talent and effective priority management
• Flexibility and adaptability to unforeseen circumstances
• Stress resistance in a dynamic and demanding environment
• Sales experience considered an asset
• Professional requirements
• Mastery of MS Office tools for planning, reporting and internal communication
• Languages
• Ideally, you live in French-speaking Switzerland and speak French fluently. German and English are more.
• Contact
• This opportunity matches your profile and expectations? Click on the POSTULER link and send us your resume.

MERCHANDIZE SWITZERLAND MARKET 100% - Swatch Group

MERCHANDIZIERUNGSMARKT SCHWEIZ 100%
Das Unternehmen
Swatch ist eine der weltweit beliebtesten Marken in der Schweizer Uhrenindustrie. Die ersten Swatch Uhren überraschten die Welt mit ihrem revolutionären Konzept, ihrem kreativen Design und ihrem provokativen Geist. Die Philosophie der Marke basiert auf Farbe, Bewegung, Leichtigkeit und Transparenz, die in jedem Swatch-Produkt und -Projekt zu finden sind. Die Marke bekräftigt ihre globale Präsenz in der Welt des Sports und der Kunst.
Um das Merchandising-Team in der Schweizer Region Romande zu stärken, rekrutiert Swatch derzeit eins/eins
Als Merchandiser sind Sie für die Dekoration von Swatch Stores in der französischsprachigen Schweiz verantwortlich. In dieser Schlüsselrolle für das Markenimage sorgen Sie für das attraktive Aussehen von Geschäften und wenden die Dekorationsrichtlinien von Visual Merchandising an.
Stellenbeschreibung
• Gesamtverantwortung von Visual Merchandising für Swatch und Flik Flak in der französischsprachigen Schweiz, Wallis, Jura und der Region Bern, einschließlich Umsetzung von Richtlinien und Respekt für das Markenimage
• Installation von attraktiven Displays und scharfer Szenografie zur Verbesserung der visuellen Wirkung und zur Erfassung der Aufmerksamkeit des Kunden
• Regelmäßige Besuche von Outlets nach kommerziellen Prioritäten, mit Kontrolle der Sortiments- und Dekorationsausrüstung
• Produktimplementierung und Anwendung von Merchandising-Plänen innerhalb von Verkaufsflächen, um eine konsistente und qualitative Präsentation zu gewährleisten
• Optimierung der Customer Journey und Anpassung der Verkaufsflächen an neue Entwicklungen, Bestandsrotationen und kommerzielle Ziele
• Überwachung und Analyse der Leistung: Überwachung von Schlüsselindikatoren (Verkäufe, Verarbeitungsraten) und Beobachtung von Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends
• Schulung, Motivation und Unterstützung von Verkaufsteams, um die optimale Installation von Kollektionen und die einwandfreie Durchführung der Ausstellung zu gewährleisten
• Vorschläge für neue Standorte oder Aktivierungsideen zur Steigerung der Werbeaktionen und zur Erhöhung der Sichtbarkeit im Laden
• Unterstützung bei Veranstaltungen und Promotionen: Vorbereitung, Installation und Koordination von speziellen Dekorationen oder VM-Projekten
• Verwaltungsmanagement einschließlich wöchentlicher Planung, Gebührenverfolgung und Koordination vor Ort
• Profil
• Kreativität und ästhetischer Sinn: ausgezeichnete Kontrolle von Raum, Volumen, Farben und Licht
• Technische und manuelle Fähigkeiten: Leichtigkeit in der Werkzeughandhabung und visuelle Installation
• Strenge und Organisation: gleichzeitiges Management mehrerer Projekte und strikte Einhaltung der Kalender der neuen Kollektionen
• Beziehungsaufbau: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Filialleitern zu kommunizieren und Teams um ein visuelles Projekt zu vereinen
• Offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit, mit begeisterten und fokussierten Lösungen
• Proaktives und unternehmerisches Verhalten: Initiativen ergreifen und ständig nach Verbesserungen suchen
• Fähigkeit, Präsentationsstandards aufzuerlegen und durchzusetzen
• Selbständigkeit und Rechenschaftspflicht bei Feldmissionen
• Verfügbarkeit für Reisen, auch für Nächte
• Organisationstalent und effektives Priority Management
• Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit an unvorhergesehene Umstände
• Stressresistenz in einem dynamischen und anspruchsvollen Umfeld
• Verkaufserfahrung als Vermögenswert
• Berufliche Anforderungen
• Beherrschung von MS Office Tools für Planung, Reporting und interne Kommunikation
• Sprachen

• Swatch Group è un'azienda multinazionale attiva nella produzione e vendita di orologi finiti e gioielli, movimenti e componenti orologi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Longines Customer Care Advisor - Swatch Group

## La società
Longines is famous for the elegance of its timepieces and is a member of the Swatch Group Ltd, the world's leading manufacturer of horological products. Based in Saint-Imier, Switzerland since 1832, Longines watchmakers enjoy an expertise steeped in tradition, elegance and performance. With generations of experience as Official Timekeeper of World Championships and as a partner of international sports federations, Longines has created lasting and durable links to the world of sport. Longines sponsors over 40 sporting events every year, including the commonwealth game and various horse racing events including Royal Ascot.

## Descrizione del lavoro

## Mansioni
- To deliver exceptional customer service, ensuring every customer interaction embodies the values of the brand.
- You will manage customer enquiries and complaints, aiming for first-contact resolution while building strong relationships with customers.
- Provide high-quality information, advice, and guidance to customers through a range of channels including phone calls and emails, resolving queries at the first point of contact.
- Proactively reach out to customers to address potential issues before they escalate, ensuring a seamless and positive experience.
- Handle and follow up on customer complaints and enquiries in a professional, timely, and responsive manner.
- Ensure complaints are resolved in a customer-focused manner, adhering to agreed service standards, while maintaining the integrity and reputation of Longines.
- Comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) ensuring efficient and effective service delivery.
- Develop into an integral member of the team, promoting clear and open communication between colleagues and customers.
- Continuously enhance your knowledge of Longines products, services, and internal procedures/policies to offer accurate and informed assistance to customers.

## Requisiti
### Essential Skills and Experience
- Exceptional written and verbal communications skills.
- Ability to build strong rapport with customers, using empathy to ensure exceptional service.
- A proactive and positive approach with the ability to anticipate customer needs, make decisions and resolve issues independently.
- Ability to maintain accuracy, professionalism and make decisions whilst working under pressure.
- Excellent time management skills and able to effectively prioritise workload .
- Skilled in conflict management and having challenging conversations.
- Strong IT skills and proficient with Microsoft Office programmes.
- Demonstrable customer service and complaint handling experience.

### Desirable Skills and Experience
- Experience using CRM and/or SAP.

### Essential Qualifications
- 5 GCSE including Maths and English (or equivalent)

As a Swatch Sales Lead, you will report to the Store Manager and will assist in all day-to-day operations. Although your focus will be on sales initiatives, you also will coach sales associates to achieve their performance goals while embodying Swatch Core Competencies: Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Build Effective Teams and Relationships, Creativity and Problem-Solving, and Humility and Integrity.

Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain - Swatch Group

Retail Sales Advisor Blancpain
The company
Blancpain, founded in 1735 by Jehan-Jacques Blancpain in the Swiss Jura, Blancpain is known as the world’s oldest watch brand.
Over the centuries since its foundation, the Maison has maintained its commitment to innovate and has constantly pushed the limits of watchmaking. At Blancpain, the expression "Innovation is our tradition" is a fundamental guiding principle.
The Fifty Fathoms collection embodies Blancpain's passion for the underwater world that was originally expressed in 1953 with the presentation of the first modern diver’s watch Fifty Fathoms.
With the creation of the Blancpain Ocean Commitment, the brand pays homage to its Brand’s significant historical links with the ocean, through the support for ocean exploration and numerous collaborative initiatives for biodiversity preservation with local communities, which has been lasting for the past seven decades.
As part of the Art of Living platform, Blancpain also cultivates special ties with the greatest award-winning chefs, the Michelin Guide, Relais & Chateaux and Bocuse d’Or.
Job description
Key
• Responsibilities
Sales and Business Development
Provide excellent client experience and timely, pertinent follow-up for both prospective clients and owners (Customer service)
Propose clients for, and participate in, local activation events in line with the Brand Universe
Support colleagues in their sales by helping to prepare invoices, gifts, packaging
Ensure requests and enquiries (online, email, phone) are followed up in a timely manner
Develop and maintain a high level of sales technique and watchmaking savoir-faire knowledge
Follow-up with customer repairs liaising with customer care in Southampton and Swiss headquarters.
Provide reliable information to customers in all matters relating to sales and customer service.
Placing orders for Blancpain accessories, ensuring stock is upto date and available
Boutique Operations
Actively participate in the proper maintenance of the boutique: product displays, props set-up, etc.
Understand and respect all operating and security guidelines
Follow the security and proper maintenance of stock timepieces
Profile
Preferred
• Profile
Previous sales experience in a luxury Retail boutique or Hospitality industry
Excellent client service and attention to details
Entrepreneurial spirit to develop your own business and build long-lasting client relationships
Team player with good interpersonal skills and a "can do" attitude
Intellectual curiosity and a passion for learning
Strong interest in the universes of Fine Watchmaking and Arts de Vivre

L'azienda
Blancpain, fondata nel 1735 da Jehan-Jacques Blancpain nella Giura Svizzera, Blancpain è conosciuta come il marchio di orologi più antico del mondo.
Nel corso dei secoli dalla sua fondazione, la Maison ha mantenuto il suo impegno a innovare e ha costantemente spinto i limiti dell'orologeria. A Blancpain, l'espressione "Innovazione è la nostra tradizione" è un principio guida fondamentale.
La collezione Fifty Fathoms incarna la passione di Blancpain per il mondo subacqueo che è stato originariamente espresso nel 1953 con la presentazione del primo orologio subacqueo moderno Fifty Fathoms.
Con la creazione del Blancpain Ocean Commitment, il marchio rende omaggio ai significativi legami storici del suo brand con l’oceano, attraverso il sostegno all’esplorazione dell’oceano e numerose iniziative di collaborazione per la conservazione della biodiversità con le comunità locali, che dura da sette decenni.
Nell’ambito della piattaforma Art of Living, Blancpain coltiva anche legami speciali con i più grandi chef premiati, la Guida Michelin, Relais & Chateaux e Bocuse d’Or.

Supporta i colleghi nelle loro vendite aiutando a preparare fatture, regali, imballaggi

Sviluppare e mantenere un alto livello di tecnica di vendita e la conoscenza savoir-faire dell'orologeria

Fornire informazioni affidabili ai clienti in tutte le questioni relative alle vendite e al servizio clienti.

titleByLocale.fr: Store Manager Bilbao

descriptionByLocale.en:
Store Manager Bilbao - Swatch Group Store Manager Bilbao The company Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries Job description SWATCH has an exciting opportunity for a Store Manager to join one of our stores in Bilbao. As a Store Manager your main tasks will be:
• Ability to build revenue, manage back-office operations and supervise selling professionals.
• Develop the strategies and plans to achieve sales results through clientelling, superior customer service, events, partnering and traffic generating actions.
• Ensure a consistent, quality store experience for customers.
• Think strategically and drive the business to company standards.
• Prioritize, plan, delegate, administrate and adapt to business needs.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques. Profile The ideal candidate should be an experienced retail sales manager with a strong focus on boosting sales, providing refined customer service and demonstrating strong customer skills. Communicative person, results and customer service oriented and with attention to Retail. The experience within the watch industry and jewelry will be a plus. Professional requirements Flexibility is also needed to adapt the changes to Store needs. Availability for shift work. Intermediate level of informatics (Office). SALES REPRESENTATIVE - OMEGA BOUTIQUE ZERMATT
Introduction de la société
OMEGA ist eine prestigeträchtige globale Marke, die seit mehr als 170 Jahren nach höchster Qualität, äußerster Präzision und immer neuen Innovationen strebt. Unsere Uhren gehören zu den besten der Welt, sie sind das Ergebnis von Technologien, die führend in der Uhrenbranche sind und sich durch ein zeitloses Design auszeichnen.
Im Laufe unserer langen Geschichte haben wir Präzisionsrekorde aufgestellt, die Sportzeitnahme entscheidend geprägt und nach wie vor nehmen wir eine Vorreiterrolle in der hohen Uhrmacherkunst ein.
Als internationale Marke sind wir immer daran interessiert, zukünftige Kollegen kennenzulernen, die bereit sind, unsere Teams auf praktisch jedem Kontinent durch ihre Talente, ihre Ambitionen und ihre Inspiration zu unterstützen.

- Sie leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zum Erfolg der Boutique und zur Erreichung der Verkaufsziele

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch oder Französisch und Englisch (zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil)

titleByLocale.fr: IT Project Manager

descriptionByLocale.en:
IT Project Manager - Swatch Group IT Project Manager The company The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
• Job description You will join a large and collaborative IT organization and play a key role in managing strategic projects across the American subsidiaries of the Group. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, enterprise architects and external partners, you will ensure the successful delivery of approved projects, from initial demand through handover to operations, while contributing to program management and supporting change initiatives. Your main responsibilities include: Managing approved IT projects according to agreed budgets, timelines and scope. Ensuring effective project execution from demand intake to operational handover, following the Group’s project management methodology. Preparing and maintaining project documentation, investment requests and decision materials. Coordinating with enterprise architects to ensure proper architectural alignment during conceptual phases. Collaborating with external partners and ensuring proper follow‑up on deliverables. Communicating regularly with stakeholders, including business teams, management, PMO and related project teams. Supporting conflict resolution, resource coordination and scope management. Contributing to program management activities and facilitating change management across impacted teams.
• Profile The ideal candidate brings: Strong experience managing IT projects in a multinational environment. The ability to lead projects end‑to‑end, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IT strategy. Solid understanding of business processes, logistics flows and project governance. The capacity to coordinate diverse stakeholders and maintain clear, structured communication. A proactive, organized and solution‑oriented mindset. The ability to manage risks, dependencies and resources in a dynamic environment. A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, architects and external partners. Strong analytical abilities and the capacity to evaluate business demands and scope potential projects. Professional requirements Required skills and experience: 10+ years of experience in IT project management. Experience working in a large multinational corporation with international exposure. Expertise in IT project management, including planning, execution and stakeholder coordination. Strong understanding of business management and logistics processes. Good knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including cloud, networking and data center environments. Experience with SAP S/4HANA or modules such as SD/MM or FI/CO is an asset. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to model information flows and support change management activities. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent. Project management certifications (PMP, Scrum Master, etc.) are considered an asset. Languages Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus. titleByLocale.fr: Data Integration Ingénieur

descriptionByLocale.en:
Data Integration Engineer - Swatch Group Data Integration Engineer The company The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
• Job description You will join the Integration Competence Center (INTCC) within the Group IT Applications Division and contribute to the design, development and support of data integration and distribution solutions for the American markets. Working closely with IT teams, architects, business stakeholders and external partners, you will help extend and operate the Group’s Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data hub, strengthen data integration capabilities and ensure the reliability of the integration landscape. Your main responsibilities include: Designing, developing and enhancing data integration and distribution solutions across brands and countries. Implementing and extending the SSOT data hub using MS SQL, stored procedures and WebMethods components. Designing robust data integration architectures and data models to support business and IT needs. Supporting governance activities related to master data, interfaces and integration processes. Providing operational support for the integration landscape, including infrastructure, applications and middleware. Collaborating with developers, architects and cross‑functional teams to ensure high‑quality integration flows. Maintaining documentation related to processes, system setup, data models and integration components.
• Profile The ideal candidate brings: Strong experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development. Data Integration Engineer
The company
The Swatch Group Ltd. in Biel (Switzerland) is the world’s largest manufacturer of finished watches. The Swatch Group is synonymous for durable, emotional consumer products of high quality. With its own worldwide network of distribution organizations, the Group is active in the manufacture of finished watches, movements and components (e.g. ETA). It produces practically all the components necessary to its watch companies.
Job description
You will join the Integration Competence Center (INTCC) within the Group IT Applications Division and contribute to the design, development and support of data integration and distribution solutions for the American markets.
Working closely with IT teams, architects, business stakeholders and external partners, you will help extend and operate the Group’s Single Source of Truth (SSOT) data hub, strengthen data integration capabilities and ensure the reliability of the integration landscape.
Your main responsibilities include:
• Designing, developing and enhancing data integration and distribution solutions across brands and countries.
• Implementing and extending the SSOT data hub using MS SQL, stored procedures and WebMethods components.
• Designing robust data integration architectures and data models to support business and IT needs.
• Supporting governance activities related to master data, interfaces and integration processes.
• Providing operational support for the integration landscape, including infrastructure, applications and middleware.
• Collaborating with developers, architects and cross‑functional teams to ensure high‑quality integration flows.
• Maintaining documentation related to processes, system setup, data models and integration components.
• Profile
• The ideal candidate brings:
• Strong experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• The ability to design and implement integration solutions across multiple systems and markets.
• Hands‑on experience with MS SQL, stored procedures, SSIS/ETL tools and related plugins.
• Familiarity with EAI/ESB technologies, ideally Software AG WebMethods or similar stacks.
• Experience with APIs, XML, SOAP and REST‑based integrations.
• Exposure to SAP integration technologies such as IDocs, RFCs or ABAP debugging.
• A structured, analytical and solution‑oriented mindset.
• The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a technical team.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.
• Professional requirements
• Required skills and experience:
• +10 years of IT experience, including at least 2 years in designing and developing data integration or MDM solutions.
• At least 5 years of experience in data integration, data modeling and SQL‑based development.
• Expertise with MS SQL, stored procedures and relational database design.
• Strong experience with SSIS/ETL tools and plugins such as Theobald for SAP‑related integrations.
• Experience with WebMethods or other EAI/ESB platforms.
• Experience in Java/JEE development and object‑oriented programming.
• Experience developing web applications (AngularJS, WebMethods CAF UI or similar).
• Strong knowledge of XML, SOAP, REST and API‑based integrations.
• Experience with SAP integration technologies (IDoc, ALE, RFC, ABAP debugging) is an advantage.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent.
• Starting base salary range between 110k-140k/year (plus a yearly bonus potential)
• Languages
• Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America - Swatch Group

Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
The company
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the worlds of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends to them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.
Job description
We are seeking an experienced, retail Store Manager to provide leadership in our store. The ideal candidate must be a seasoned Retail Manager with a strong focus on driving sales and delivering excellent customer service.
Profile
• Achieve goals through execution of our productivity program, team-member coaching and outstanding client service.
• Ensure a consistent and respectable store experience for our customers.
• Be able to think strategically and efficiently while running the store as per company standards.
• Possess the ability to prioritize, plan, delegate, and adapt to business needs at various times.
• Maximize inventory, cash control and loss prevention techniques.
• Ensure proper staffing of the store through recruitment and retention.
• Create and foster a nourishing environment for the team to strive and succeed.
• Develop and guide a large team of employees.
• Professional requirements
• 3-5 years of retail Store Management experience required for all candidates, specialty retail preferred
• Passion for the delivering the culture of the SWATCH Brand
• Excellent organizational, communication and computer skills.
• Ability to lead and sustain an efficiently operating and cohesive store.
• Team-oriented
• Benefits Program
• The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
• Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
• Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
• Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
• 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
• 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
• Holiday pay
• Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Employee product discount
• Internal transfer and growth potential
• $500 Employee Referral Bonuses
• For more information, please see: https://transparency-in-coverage.uhc.com/

• East Broadway 162
• 55425 Bloomington MN (Minnesota)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America - Swatch Group

Swatch Store Manager - Mall of America
L'azienda
Swatch abbraccia i valori che coesistono nei mondi dell'arte, del design, della moda e della tecnologia; e conferisce loro la propria scintilla di creatività. Così, Swatch è considerato una tela su cui sono state applicate una miriade di espressioni. Stile taglio bordo, impostazione tendenza look e accenti tecnologia amichevole hanno tutti aggiunto allo stupore di possedere un Swatch.
Descrizione del lavoro
Stiamo cercando un esperto, Retail Store Manager per fornire la leadership nel nostro negozio. Il candidato ideale deve essere un Retail Manager esperto con una forte attenzione alla guida delle vendite e alla fornitura di un servizio clienti eccellente.
Profilo

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Visual Merchandiser & Trainer – Travel Retail & Cruise Ships - Swatch Group

### The company
Tissot, watchmakers blending tradition and pioneering spirit since 1853.
Nestled in the Swiss mountains of Le Locle, Tissot crafts watches that become the storytellers of life's voyage: it's not just the destination that matters, but the importance of the path filled with significant milestones and unforgettable memories. The brand’s ambassadors, including American basketball star Damian Lillard, Italian motorcycling sensation Enea Bastianini, Slovenian cyclist Primož Roglič, and Chinese Actors Liu Yifei and Simon Gong exemplify the hours of dedication preceding one’s excellence. On a broader stage, Tissot also partners with the NBA, MotoGPTM, and the Tour de France as their Official Timekeeper.
Discover Tissot’s collections: T-Touch, PRX, Chemin des Tourelles. Every Swiss timepiece crafted embodies a fusion of heritage and innovation, and while priced accessibly, stands as an enduring legacy defying the constraints of time. Going beyond watchmaking and timekeeping, Tissot accompanies individuals in every moment, celebrating not only the achievements, but the journey itself.

### Job description
As a Visual Merchandiser & Trainer with Swatch Group, U.S., you will play a key role in supporting watch sales within our travel retail which is airports and cruise ship wholesale accounts by driving visual merchandising excellence and delivering impactful training. You will oversee the brand’s visual representation in all boutiques across the assigned region and maintain training initiatives to increase brand and product knowledge among the dedicated channel teams.
Tasks include the planning, organization, coordination, training and implementation of all Visual Merchandising measures that have been developed by the Brands. The role will require travel throughout the US, predominantly within the main Cruise ports of Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Port Canaveral, Galveston, Los Angeles and Seattle.
This position is a hybrid position.

### Profile
#### Primary Duties and Responsibilities
##### Visual Merchandising Responsibilities
- Implement and maintain visual merchandising standards across retail and wholesale store locations, ensuring compliance with Company guidelines and brand standards.
- Conduct regular store visits to evaluate visual execution, providing on-the-spot adjustments and recommendations.
- Contribute to achieving sales volume goals by ensuring effective presentations and maintenance of all product categories, making sure that all stores are set up correctly during promotions and regular business.
- Prepare and distribute communication materials related to visual displays in accordance with brand guidelines.
- Manage vendor relationships by placing and following up on visual orders to ensure timely implementation and centralized mailing of visual materials to trade location.
- Coordinate internal distribution of visual materials to stores, ensuring compliance and visibility.
- Collaborate with retail locations, regional teams, and brand leadership to plan and execute floor sets, window displays, seasonal transitions, and promotional setups.
- Identify visual merchandising opportunities within and outside stores, developing innovative window decoration ideas.
- Create and maintain a photo library documenting boutique conditions before and after visits.
- Provide recap reports summarizing store visit findings and improvement recommendations.
- Assist Visual Manager and SIS Project Manager with identifying SIS opportunities and maintenance/renovation needs.
- Lead first-class setup and decoration of brand-sponsored events, mono- and multi-brand related, to maximize visual impact.
##### Training & Development Responsibilities
- Facilitate training sessions for store managers and associates focused on current visual merchandising standards, product placement, and customer experience best practices.
- Provide comprehensive communication and training programs to stores
- Partner with management on planning and executing functional, leadership, product, and sales training programs.
- Provide ongoing coaching to store teams, identifying skill gaps and recommending development initiatives.
- Foster strong relationships with store teams to support adoption of visual and training standards.
##### Additional Responsibilities
- Monitor regional business trends, competitor trends by reading and understanding business reports and identify potential opportunities to support sales growth.
- Perform other duties as assigned by management.

### Professional requirements
#### Education and Experience Requirements
- High School Diploma or GED required; College degree preferred.
- 2-3 years of retail visual merchandising experience, preferably in specialty goods, jewelry, or watches.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
- Valid driver’s license required.
- Proven ability to coach and train diverse teams in a fast-paced retail environment.
- Strong eye for design, layout, and brand storytelling through product presentation.
- Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
- Must be willing to work weekends on the work schedule. The work schedule will vary from Monday through Sunday with 5 days on and 2 days off. Anticipated schedule will be Tuesday through Saturday on the standard schedule.
- Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 80-85% of the time (minimum 4 days per workweek).
#### Additional Skill Requirements:
- Able to organize and execute presentations
- Must be a confident communicator and presenter
- Must be self-motivated and a self-starter; quick learner for a multifaceted business and companion domestic and international staff;
- Must possess strong organizational, project management and problem-solving skills with multi-tasking abilities in a fast-paced corporate environment;
- Understand and follow work rules and procedures
- Must be a team player
- Must be able to travel via plane, car or mode of transportation as prescribed by management within the US Domestic territory

### Physical Requirements:
This is primarily active position which requires the Visual Merchandiser & Trainer – Travel Retail & Cruise Ships to move about the various locations while continuously climbing ladders, bending, stooping, lifting, reaching, moving and carrying up to 40 lbs. There is frequent travel to multiple retail locations within assigned territory. The position requires the ability to operate motor vehicles, computers and tablets, communicate clearly, and engage physically with visual merchandising setups. It will require ability to operate motor vehicle, computer and tablet equipment, speak, hear, and direct others. Finger dexterity is necessary. Occasional evening or weekend work to support store openings, seasonal transitions, or special events.

### Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
- Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
- Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
- 18 days of PTO per year

## Junior Financial Analyst - Swatch Group

## Descrizione
The Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components. Swatch Group unites, among other companies, the following watch brands under its roof: Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak. The Group has a strong distribution and multi-brand retail net with two sophisticated boutiques under the name of Tourbillon and Hour Passion. Swatch Group is also an important player in advanced nanomechanical, nanoelectronic and Bluetooth technologies essential to watchmaking and other industries.

## Job Description
The Swatch Group US is looking for a Junior Financial Analyst to join our Corporate Finance team. This role supports daily treasury operations, cash management, and liquidity analysis, helping ensure the organization’s financial stability and efficient cash flow.

## Profile
The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, ability to build relationships with internal and external clients, be self-motivated, proactive, energetic, detail-oriented, assertive and efficient. They would be able to work in a team environment, think creatively and perform with enthusiasm.

This is an office based position in Miami, Florida.

## Responsibilities
- Setting up bank vault service for new boutiques or change service when needed
- Cash Pickup service & Vendor management
- Security Product Ordering for boutiques
- Handling of daily accounting tasks
- Reconcile sales to cash collected
- Support the month-end close process by providing accurate cash and debt data.
- Review and resolve discrepancies between sales and cash collection
- Assist in preparing variance analysis reports
- Support audits and ensure accurate recordkeeping of treasury transactions.
- Researches and responds to inquiries from internal team members, management and related parties
- Assist with other projects assigned by Management

## Professional requirements
### Requirements
- 1-3 years of experience in similar position and/or environment
- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or similar field is preferred
- Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong interpersonal skills
- Must be organized, accurate, thorough, and able to monitor work for quality
- Strong analytical skills and problem solving skills
- Have a working knowledge of IFRS/GAAP principles.
- Attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong learning ability and problem solving skills
- Able to build relationships with internal and external clients
- Strong time management skills and ability to be both effective and efficient in work
- Advanced computer skills including Microsoft Office; Excellent Excel skills
- Able to work well with minimal supervision; self-starter, pro-active

## Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
- Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
- Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
- 18 days of PTO per year
- Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
- Holiday pay
- Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
- Employee product discount

## Descrizione
Swatch Full Time Sales Associate - Times Square - Swatch Group

## Descrizione
Swatch embraces the values that coexist in the world of art, design, fashion and technology; and lends them its own spark of creativity. Thus, Swatch is considered a canvas upon which a myriad of expressions have been applied. Cutting edge style, trend setting looks and technology friendly accents have all added to the amazement of owning a Swatch.

## Job description
A Superb Opportunity…
At Swatch we provide our Retail Sales Associates with the training and support that lays the groundwork for a professional career with real momentum. As a member of the Retail Sales Team, you will be coached on sales techniques and customer service skills along with technical training on all our watches and services. Plus, your base-plus-commission pay structure is designed so that the sky is the limit for motivated and knowledgeable retail sales professionals.

## Profile
Primary Responsibilities:
- Greet customers in a timely, professional and personable manner
- Use product knowledge and selection to provide exceptional service and build customer relationships
- Reach & exceed your sales goals
- Be a self-starter and use good judgment in all situations
- Handle multi-tasking with ease
- Perform merchandising tasks; stock replenishment, visual display, and upkeep of the organization and cleanliness of the store environment

## Professional requirements
Qualifications:
- 1-2 years of experience in a retail sales position, specialty retail preferred.
- Driven to deliver superior service to your customers
- Engage your customers in the culture of the SWATCH brand
- Able to work well as a team player in a fast-paced, energetic environment
- Able to plan, set and achieve goals

## Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability and we are happy to offer a competitive benefits package that includes:
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
- Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year
- Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
- 18 PTO days per year, 23 PTO after 5 years
- 7 days per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
- Holiday pay
- Voluntary Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
- Employee product discount
- Internal transfer and growth potential
- $500 Employee Referral Bonuses

## Compensation
- Base Pay plus Commission
- Hourly Rate: $18.00 - $20.00/Hr. plus commission

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Visual Merchandiser & Trainer - Mid-Atlantic - Swatch Group

### The company
Tissot, innovators by tradition
Since 1853, Tissot has been at the heart of Swiss watchmaking. Our dedication to craftsmanship and quality is matched only by our passion for performance and precision. Over the years, our pioneering products such as the legendary Tissot T-Touch have made headlines as well as history. The ground-breaking Tissot T-Touch Connect Solar uses sustainable solar energy and connected technology that guarantees privacy. It confirms our long-held reputation as innovators by tradition.

### Job description
As a Visual Merchandiser & Trainer with Tissot, U.S., the position will be responsible to support the watch sales within our retail and wholesale account through visual merchandising and training. This role will oversee the visual representation of our Tissot brand and products in all boutiques (retail and wholesale) within assigned Mid-Atlantic region. Visual Merchandiser & Trainer will also be responsible for maintaining training initiatives that will increase Tissot brand and product knowledge. Tasks include the planning, organization, coordination, training and implementation of all Visual Merchandising measures that have been developed by the Tissot.

This position is a field position.

### Profile
#### Primary Duties and Responsibilities
- Responsible for ensuring that store merchandise presentations meet Company standards and are in accordance with Company guidelines.
- Preparation of all communication materials as per visual displays in accordance to brand’s guidelines.
- Training of Store Managers and associates on current visual and brand standards.
- Contribute to achieving sales volume goals by ensuring effective presentations and maintenance of all product categories, making sure that all stores are set up correctly during promotions and regular business.
- Manage directly with vendor and place and follow up on all visual orders to ensure that all visual needs are implemented on time.
- Coordinate with visibility internal on centralized mailing of visual materials to trade and ensure the stores place them.
- Partner with management in planning and executing functional training, leadership development, product and sales training and other needed training strategies.
- Provide comprehensive communication and training programs to stores
- Look for any visual opportunities within or outside the stores and come up with great window decoration ideas.
- Identify possible business opportunities, keeping abreast of regional business trends by reading and understanding business reports
- Create and maintain photo library of boutique conditions prior to and after a visit
- Provide a recap report of the store visits
- Realize first-in-class set up and decoration of the Brands sponsored events, mono- and multi-brand related events, in order to maximize the Brand ’s visual impact according to brand guidelines.
- All duties assigned by Management

#### Professional requirements
##### Education and Experience Requirements
- High School Diploma or GED required
- College degree in Marketing, Merchandising and Design preferred.
- 2-3 years of retail visual merchandising experience in specialty goods, jewelry, watches and related a plus.
- Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Proficiency in Word, Excel and PowerPoint required.
- Must be motivated and a self-starter.
- Ability to foster relationships and maintain connections
- Must thrive in a fast-paced, fluid environment and be able to prioritize multiple responsibilities, projects
- Able to work weekends as needed; Travel up to 80%.

##### Additional Skill Requirements:
- Able to organize and execute presentations
- Must be a confident communicator and presenter
- Must be self-motivated and a self-starter; quick learner for a multifaceted business and companion domestic and international staff;
- Must possess strong organizational, project management and problem-solving skills with multi-tasking abilities in a fast-paced corporate environment;
- Understand and follow work rules and procedures
- Must be a team player

### Benefits Program
The Swatch Group is an equal opportunity employer that promotes diversity and is committed to environmental sustainability.
- Excellent health, dental and vision insurance (employee and dependents are eligible 1st of the month following 30 days; generous employer contribution)
- Immediate participation in the 401(k) and 100% vested employer match after one year (maximum 4% employer match with 5% employee contribution)
- Company paid life insurance and Long Term Disability
- 18 days of PTO per year, 1 Month PTO after 5 years
- Special bucket of sick time per year extended paid time for medical, parental and military leave
- Holiday pay
- Voluntary FSA, STD, Accident/Hospital Indemnity insurance
- Employee product discount

The Swatch Group is the world's number one manufacturer of finished watches. With its 16 watch brands, the Group is present in all price segments, and is also active in the manufacture and sale of jewelry, watch movements and components.

## Job description
As the Accounts Payable Clerk with Swatch Group, U.S., the position will be responsible for processing of all vendor payments, including invoice data entry, check writing, proper accounts posting, report generation, and meeting established pay date deadlines, internal and external according to established schedules.

This is an on-site position, Monday through Friday. The candidate must have a solid background in accounts payable.

## Profile
- Review all invoices for appropriate documentation and approval prior to payment
- Matching invoices with purchase orders & enter invoices in accounting system for payment
- Prioritize invoices according to cash discount potential and payment terms
- Process check requests, enter manual check, process credit card bills, and weekly check runs
- Maintain vendor files & respond to all vendors inquires
- Reconcile vendor statements, research and correct discrepancies
- Maintain files and documentation thoroughly and accurately
- Communicate with vendors, and business partners via phone, e-mail or mail
- 1099 maintenance

- Ensure all invoices are coded to the correct GL accounts and budgets
- Assist in scanning and filing documents
- Interact professionally with management and other departments for invoice coding, approvals and disputes
- Partner with departments to review and process aged items weekly
- Process new vendor set up requests (Domestic and International)
- Verifies vendor accounts by reconciling monthly statements and related transactions
- Answer vendor inquiries and interact with vendors regarding issues relating to invoices
- Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

## Professional requirements
### Education and Experience Requirements
- High school diploma required, college courses in accounting preferred
- Minimum 2 years of experience in an corporate accounts payable/accounting role required
- Must be proficiency with the financial system SAP
- Must have intermediate or advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, VLOOKUP and high level functions

Beschreibung
Die Swatch Group ist der weltweit führende Hersteller von Uhren. Mit seinen 16 Uhrenmarken ist die Gruppe in allen Preissegmenten vertreten und ist auch bei der Herstellung und dem Verkauf von Schmuck, Uhrenbewegungen und Komponenten aktiv.

Jobbeschreibung
Als Accounts Payable Clerk mit der Swatch Group, US, wird die Position für die Verarbeitung aller Anbieter-Zahlungen verantwortlich sein, einschließlich Rechnungsdateneintrag, Kontrollschreiben, ordnungsgemäße Kontenbuchung, Reportgenerierung und Erfüllung etablierter Zahlungstermine, intern und extern nach festgelegten Zeitplan.

Dies ist eine Position vor Ort, Montag bis Freitag. Der Kandidat muss einen soliden Hintergrund in Konten zu zahlen haben.

Profil
- Überprüfen Sie alle Rechnungen für eine entsprechende Dokumentation und Genehmigung vor der Zahlung
- Passende Rechnungen mit Kaufaufträgen & Rechnungseingaben im Rechnungswesen zur Zahlung
- Priorisieren Sie Rechnungen nach Cash-Rabatt-Potential und Zahlungsbedingungen
- Prozess-Check-Anfragen, manuelle Überprüfung, Prozess-Kreditkartenrechnungen und wöchentliche Check-Läufe
- Erhalten Sie Hersteller-Dateien und reagieren auf alle Anbieter Anfragen
- Reconcile Vendor Aussagen, Forschung und korrekte Diskrepanzen
- Akten und Dokumentationen sorgfältig und genau
- Kommunikation mit Anbietern und Geschäftspartnern per Telefon, E-Mail oder E-Mail

- Assist beim Scannen und Anmelden von Dokumenten
- Interagieren Sie professionell mit Management und anderen Abteilungen für Rechnungscodierung, Genehmigungen und Streitigkeiten
- Partner mit Abteilungen zu überprüfen und zu bearbeiten alter Gegenstände wöchentlich
- Bearbeitung neuer Anbieter erstellt Anfragen (Domestic und International)
- Verifiziert die Verkäuferkonten durch Abstimmung von monatlichen Aussagen und damit verbundenen Transaktionen
- Beantworten Sie die Anfragen und interagieren Sie mit Anbietern über Fragen rund um Rechnungen
- Sonstige Aufgaben und Zuständigkeiten als zugewiesen.

Professionelle Anforderungen
Anforderungen an Bildung und Erfahrung
- Hochschuldiplom erforderlich, College-Kurse in der Buchhaltung bevorzugt
- Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer zu zahlenden Unternehmensrechnung/Berechnungsrolle erforderlich
- Muss mit dem Finanzsystem SAP erfolgreich sein
- Muss mittlere oder fortgeschrittene Excel-Fähigkeiten einschließlich Schwenktabellen, VLOOKUP und High Level-Funktionen haben
- Muss ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten haben; starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.
- Muss organisiert werden, genau, gründlich und in der Lage, die Arbeit für Qualität zu überwachen

- Muss starke analytische Fähigkeiten besitzen;

- Starke Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeit, sowohl effektiv als auch effizient in der Arbeit zu sein
- Effizienz in allen Microsoft Office-Anwendungen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione
Le Swatch Group est le premier fabricant mondial de montres finies. Avec ses 16 marques horlogères, le Groupe est présent dans tous les segments de prix et est également actif dans la fabrication et la vente de bijoux, de mouvements de montres et de composants.

Description du poste
En tant que commis aux comptes créditeurs du Swatch Group, aux États-Unis, le poste sera chargé de traiter tous les paiements des fournisseurs, y compris la saisie des données sur les factures, la vérification écrite, l'affichage des comptes, la production de rapports et le respect des échéances établies pour la date de paye, à l'interne et à l'externe, conformément aux calendriers établis.

C'est une position sur place, du lundi au vendredi. Le candidat doit avoir une solide connaissance des comptes créditeurs.

Profil
- Examiner toutes les factures pour obtenir la documentation appropriée et l'approbation avant le paiement
- Correspondance des factures avec les bons de commande et saisie des factures dans le système de comptabilité pour le paiement
- Privilégier les factures selon le potentiel d'escompte en espèces et les modalités de paiement
- Traitement des demandes de contrôle, saisie des vérifications manuelles, traitement des factures de carte de crédit et des vérifications hebdomadaires
- Tenir les fichiers des fournisseurs et répondre à tous les fournisseurs demande
- Réconcilier les déclarations des fournisseurs, rechercher et corriger les écarts
- Tenir à jour les dossiers et la documentation de façon approfondie et précise
- Communiquer avec les fournisseurs et les partenaires commerciaux par téléphone, courriel ou courrier
- 1099 entretien
- Aide en fin de mois et fin d'exercice
- Aider à traiter les factures des fournisseurs en volume élevé et des fournisseurs non associés
- S'assurer que toutes les factures sont codées dans les comptes et budgets GL corrects
- Aider à la numérisation et au classement des documents
- Interagir professionnellement avec la direction et d'autres ministères pour le codage des factures, les approbations et les différends
- Collaborer avec les ministères pour examiner et traiter les articles âgés chaque semaine
- Traitement des demandes de création de nouveaux fournisseurs (domestique et international)
- Vérifier les comptes des fournisseurs en rapprochant les relevés mensuels et les opérations connexes
- Répondre aux demandes des fournisseurs et interagir avec les fournisseurs au sujet des questions relatives aux factures
- Autres fonctions et responsabilités assignées.

Exigences professionnelles
Exigences en matière d'éducation et d'expérience
- Diplôme d'études secondaires requis, cours d'université en comptabilité préféré
- Minimum de 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de comptabilité/de créditeurs d'entreprise
- Doit être une compétence avec le système financier SAP
- Doit avoir des compétences Excel intermédiaires ou avancées incluant des tables de pivot, VLOOKUP et des fonctions de haut niveau
- Doit avoir d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite; de solides aptitudes interpersonnelles.
- Doit être organisé, précis, approfondi et capable de surveiller le travail pour la qualité
- Connaissance approfondie des systèmes et procédures applicables des comptes créditeurs/du grand livre général, plan financier des comptes
- Attention aux détails et précision
- Doit posséder de solides compétences analytiques;
- Forte capacité d'apprentissage et de résolution de problèmes
- Compétences solides en gestion du temps et aptitude à être à la fois efficace et efficiente dans le travail
- Compétence dans toutes les applications Microsoft Office

Langues
- Le Swatch Group est un employeur à égalité de chances qui promeut la diversité et qui est engagé en faveur de la durabilité environnementale.

Avantages
- Excellente assurance santé, soins dentaires et vision (les employés et les personnes à charge sont admissibles 1er du mois suivant 30 jours; généreuse contribution de l'employeur)
- Participation immédiate aux 401k) et 100 % de l'employeur après un an (maximum 4 % de l'employeur correspond à 5 % de la contribution des employés)
- Assurance vie et invalidité de longue durée
- 18 jours de PTO par an
- Seau spécial de temps de maladie par an prolongé de temps payé pour les congés médicaux, parentaux et militaires
- Indemnité de vacances
- Assurance volontaire contre les accidents du travail, les maladies sexuellement transmissibles, les accidents du travail et l ' hospitalisation
- Réduction sur les produits employés
